html: IV. חמשׁ (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; perhaps cf. Arabic خَمِيسٌ army, Sab. חֿמס men of a tribe who can bear arms; √ then poss. = I. חמשׁ (e.g. army as composed of five parts) v. Lane Frey; also Sab.Denkm.24, which cites tribus (from tres), quartier (from quartus quatuor); > Thes MV al. who comp. Arabic حَمَسَ be firm strong, حَمِسَ be courageous, etc.)
